disableOverflow.name: Disable Overflow
disableOverflow.description: If true, the '...' pagination overflow will not render page links between the first and last rendered buttons.

itemsShown.name: Items Shown
itemsShown.description: The number of items to be shown (minimum of 4 unless props.items < 4).

loop.name: Loop
loop.description: Whether user should be able to loop through the items when reaching first / last.

size.name: Size
size.description: Specify the size of the PaginationNav.

tooltipAlignment.name: Tooltip Alignment
tooltipAlignment.description: Specify the alignment of the tooltip for the icon-only prev/next buttons.

tooltipPosition.name: Tooltip Position
tooltipPosition.description: Specify the position of the tooltip for the icon-only prev/next buttons.
